description: Revert to the historically proven aggressive hyperparameter configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) which consistently achieves better convergence (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, as the current best result (0.9800) was an outlier achieved with a conservative LR (0.08) that likely under-utilized the available time, and repeated attempts to replicate the aggressive setup have failed only due to transient instability or reversion to the conservative baseline in previous turns.
